name: HowToBuySaaS

sources.title: Homepage — full-lifecycle SaaS marketplace: discovery, vendor growth, private deal flow
List Your SaaS — public marketplace listing plans: Growth $29 lifetime, Enterprise $199 lifetime, Stripe checkout

requirements: Product must be a SaaS; vendors provide factual product info HTBS reviews before publication ('may request corrections, clarification, or additional information')

Public listing plans are one-time lifetime purchases: Growth $29 (profile, overview, one category, logo/visuals, website CTA) or Enterprise $199 (richer profile, more categories, vendor update access, priority corrections)
Site explicitly disclaims: a paid listing does NOT buy a favorable review, ranking, dofollow backlink, or guaranteed traffic
preparation: Factual description: what it does, target users, key capabilities, use cases, integrations
Official product URL for the listing CTA
Check whether a profile already exists — there's a separate 'Claim Your SaaS Profile' route
workflow: Choose Growth ($29) or Enterprise ($199) and pay via Stripe
Submit product information and assets for HTBS review
Listing publishes as a public product profile under a relevant category
watchFor: No free tier — cheapest entry is $29
Separate private marketplace (sell/raise/buy SaaS) uses monthly subscriptions — don't confuse the two funnels
Upsell surface is large: launch spotlight, newsletter sponsorship, ads, sponsored content, growth services — all separate paid products
Link benefit is explicitly disclaimed; this is a buyer-facing profile, not an SEO play
countsAsLive: A public product profile page for the SaaS exists on howtobuysaas.com under its category
unknowns: Whether links in profiles are dofollow (site disclaims selling dofollow links)
